dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop structures are visible along the dorsal ridge, characterized by high-intensity light-gray perimeters (3-5 pixels wide) transitioning sharply to low-intensity dark cores. The three most prominent annuli show jagged, non-uniform edge geometry with pixel-level 'C' shaped gaps in the high-intensity boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed in the anterior-dorsal quadrant, with individual blobs averaging 10-20 square pixels in area, interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal plane form an obtuse triangle with an approximate 140-degree internal angle, while a secondary cluster of four high-intensity blobs forms a non-convex quadrilateral posterior to the primary annuli group.
